key_findings: Sciatic CCI in rats increased IL-1beta and iNOS and decreased Nrf2/HO-1; AGM and AGM-NLCs (20 mg/kg, 14 days) reversed these and reduced allodynia and hyperalgesia.
The Nrf2 antagonist ATRA lowered Nrf2 and worsened thermal hyperalgesia, while AGM-NLCs upregulated Nrf2 and HO-1, implicating the Nrf2/HO-1 pathway.
